# GAPS — Growth Accelerator Program for SMEs (https://gapsindia.com/)

A full year of structured support for India's MSME owners, built and led by Rajiv K Chawla. Founder & Lead Mentor: Rajiv K Chawla. Enrolment by application only.

## Why this exists

You run the business well. The other half is where owners run blind. Six gaps trip up almost every MSME owner. From today, you do not close them alone.

1. **Schemes** — Subsidies you may qualify for and never claimed. We help you discover and file them.
2. **Structure** — A large company still run like a proprietorship. Holding entities and governance in place.
3. **Succession** — The next generation, equity splits and written rules, set before you need them.
4. **Capital** — Finance beyond the CC limit. Debt, equity and working capital as tools, not threats.
5. **Legal** — Contracts, IP and disputes. The small clauses that decide the size of the cheque.
6. **Peers** — Other owners at your scale, comparing notes no consultant on retainer can give.

## What GAPS is

Not a course. A full year, on three pillars. A team that has solved this before, now on your side.

- **Pillar 01 — Personalised Support**: 7 counsels, 1 relationship
- **Pillar 02 — Structured Training**: 30 touchpoints
- **Pillar 03 — Astro-Numerology**: You + family

## Pillar 01 — The Core

One relationship. The whole panel behind it. Every domain your business touches, handled by people who have done it before: Legal & IP, Tax & GST, Subsidies, Funding, Operations, Succession.

"When a decision comes up, you do not face it alone. You bring it to people who have solved it before."

## Pillar 02 — The Rhythm of the Year

A steady rhythm, all year long. Two online sessions every month, run by domain experts, plus six in-person events through the year (scheduled through the year, not fixed to set months).

24 online + 6 offline = 30 touchpoints a year.

Session topics include: GeM portal, ITR, GST, Labour laws, Hiring. In-person gatherings bring members together from across India.

## A benefit beyond the year — Germany

Nominations to a fully sponsored 21-day training in Germany. Selected members are put forward for an immersion in the home of world-class manufacturing. Travel and stay sponsored.

- 21 days — Immersion on the ground in Germany
- Fully sponsored — Travel and stay covered for those selected
- Manufacturing — Factories, engineering and best practice
- By nomination — Members put forward through the year

"A door most owners never get to open, opened for you. You go as part of a group, never on your own."

## Pillar 03 — Astro-Numerology (a considered input)

A dimension most programmes ignore, offered here with intent. One more considered input alongside the numbers, never a replacement for them.

- Personal consultation — One to one with Rajiv sir.
- Detailed report — In writing, for you and family.

Your decisions at the centre, with timing, names, launches and family each in considered orbit around them.

## Your coach — Rajiv K Chawla

Someone the Indian SME establishment already trusts.

"I have run businesses, lost them, rebuilt them, and watched the same gaps trip up almost every owner I have met. GAPS is the programme I wish someone had built for me at thirty-five."

## The expert panel — nine experts, always with you

Governance, tax, GST and wealth — the veterans who keep your foundations sound:

1. **CS Dr. Ajay Garg** — Corporate Governance. Company Secretary and doctorate, 35+ years in governance, board structuring and compliance.
2. **CA Sangeet K Gupta** — Direct Tax & Financial Health. Chartered Accountant, 30+ years in direct tax strategy and audit readiness for owner-run books.
3. **CA Rajesh K Khandelwal** — GST & Indirect Tax. Fellow CA, CS, LLB and CPA (Ireland). GST faculty for NACIN, 500+ tax lectures.
4. **Nirmal Bansal** — Wealth Management. UCLA-trained wealth counsel, helping owners grow personal wealth kept separate from the business.
5. **Lekhraj Sharma** — Chief Nodal Officer. 30 years inside administrative systems. Coordinates meetings and looks after your overall member experience.

Subsidy, growth and law — the hands-on operators:

6. **Parminder Singh** — Chief Subsidy Officer. 30+ years in central and state schemes, supporting SMEs to claim grants and incentives.
7. **Shubham Verma** — Growth, GTM & Digital. Serial founder and Shark Tank India finalist. Advises on AI adoption, digital and new-market entry.
8. **Adv. Rahul Gautam** — Legal, Supreme Court. Supreme Court advocate, 10+ years in commercial law, contracts and dispute resolution.
9. **Sudiep Kumar** — Placement & Recruitment. Built leadership teams for growing companies. Helps you hire the people who can actually run the business.

The point: 9 experts. Every domain covered. 800+ owners guided. 1 relationship, all year.

## The honest maths — what a year of GAPS is actually worth

Priced separately, the access alone runs past twenty lakh:

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Personalised access to the 7-counsel panel and Rajiv, all year | ₹5,00,000 |
| 24 expert-led online sessions (GeM, ITR, GST, labour, hiring) | ₹1,20,000 |
| 6 in-person events across the year | ₹1,20,000 |
| Nomination for a fully sponsored 21-day Germany training | ₹10,00,000 |
| Subsidy and scheme discovery plus filing support | ₹1,50,000 |
| Company structuring, governance and succession | ₹1,50,000 |
| Legal and tax resolution, plus astro report (you and family) | ₹1,00,000 |

Priced separately, a year of this is worth, on average: **₹21,00,000+**. GAPS offers all of it for **₹2,40,000**.

Subsidies you become eligible to claim through the year: **₹10L to ₹2Cr**, based on your sector, size and eligibility. This is the real argument.

## Pricing — one programme, one year

GAPS Premium is the full year. All three pillars, under one enrolment. No tiers, no add-ons.

**GAPS Premium — ₹2.4L + GST** (worth ₹21,00,000+ in advisory access). A full year. All three pillars. Includes:

1. Full 7-counsel panel as your extended team, all year
2. Direct access to Rajiv sir

4. 6 in-person events across the year
5. Nomination for the 21-day Germany training

Price exclusive of GST. Seats are limited and confirmed after the fit call.
